attribution_rules: direct_observation: verbatim quote or measurable fact from events.jsonl

inference: analyst structural reading; not established fact

incidents.label: Relational acknowledgement dispute — afternoon Jun 26
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi asks Alex to acknowledge an unspoken past conversation; he says he cannot acknowledge what she will not name. He then sends 392 words of disclosure across 76 seconds immediately before arriving; she had a 37-minute gap and no recorded window to hear them.
incidents.outcome: Unresolved. Alex left. Naomi's first question sent at 21:57 (B049).

incidents.label: Keyboard warrior trigger and overnight escalation
incidents.neutral_description: Escalation over ~4.5 hours into mutual character attack. The 'keyboard warrior' comment is a re-entry 1m58s after a declared exit; rebuttal 72 seconds later. Turn rate goes 5.1/hr to 25.6/hr.
incidents.outcome: Cessation without agreement. B122/B127/B128 cited from CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md §8.5 only — no verbatim transcript.

incidents.label: Boundary and flirtation clarification — friendship termination declared
incidents.neutral_description: Alex re-initiates, asks three specific clarifying questions about flirtation (all unanswered), then declares the friendship ended. Naomi describes it as emotional blackmail.
incidents.outcome: Friendship declared ended by Alex. 6.8-day silence follows (CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md §3).

incidents.label: Reconnection after 6.8-day silence
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi breaks the 6.8-day silence. Alex's acknowledgement demand arrives on his third turn, followed by a conditional withdrawal offer.
incidents.outcome: Transitions to AFT-02 within same session.

incidents.label: Acknowledgement deadlock — first contact session
incidents.neutral_description: Alex names hurt and anxiety, states acknowledgement as a precondition for meeting. Naomi: 'What am I acknowledging?' Structurally identical to CONF-01, 15 days on.
incidents.outcome: No acknowledgement given. Session continues to AFT-03.

incidents.label: Conflicting accounts of Jun 26 — mischaracterisation dispute
incidents.neutral_description: Competing accounts of Jun 26. Naomi's voice-message timing account, third corpus instance. Alex exits; Naomi continues post-exit with the first dinner-debt mention.
incidents.outcome: Alex exits (G183). S-AM-1 closes 22:53:24. Gap 62.6 min to S-AM-2 (computed).

incidents.label: Attentiveness dispute — did Alex read her messages?
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi challenges whether Alex read or listened to anything; states she has the conversation screenshotted. Alex's side absent from the corpus.
incidents.confidence: Moderate. Naomi's audio confirmed; Alex's side unknown.
incidents.outcome: No resolution recorded. S-AM-2 closes 00:04:10. Gap 66.2 min to S-AM-3 (computed).
incidents.participants_note: Naomi audio only. Alex's replies implied by G030 framing but absent from corpus (CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md §7.2D).

incidents.label: Explicit apology demand — claim about prior knowledge via Nishant — conditional patience stated
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi's explicit apology demand — the closest specification in the corpus of what she states she needed. Raises the Nishant prior-knowledge claim. Alex's side absent.
incidents.confidence: Moderate. Naomi's audio confirmed; Alex's side unknown.
incidents.outcome: Naomi states she will wait. S-AM-3 ends 01:31:53. ~42-hour gap before S-AM-4.
incidents.participants_note: Naomi audio only. Alex's replies implied by G188 framing but absent from corpus.

claim_status_notes.G094: Participant account only. No corpus event independently establishes what Nishant communicated to Alex or when. Recurs at G211 (AFT-13).
claim_status_notes.G187: Naomi says she was forced into vulnerability — participant account.

incidents.label: Single mutual acknowledgement event — bilateral apology — personal disclosure
incidents.neutral_description: The only substantive acknowledgement and apology from Alex in the corpus, following Naomi's apology. Non-specific, no named harms. Alex exits while driving.
incidents.outcome: Both parties apologised. Alex exits while driving (G191, 20:09:52). 23-min pause; S-AM-4 continues at AFT-07.

incidents.label: Conflict reopened — apology negotiation — boundary declaration as inflection point
incidents.neutral_description: Conflict reopens 23.1 minutes after the acknowledgement. Apology-format negotiation; Naomi names her boundary declaration as the inflection point.

incidents.label: Alex refers to a past suicide attempt — harm identification — partial de-escalation stated
incidents.neutral_description: Alex frames himself as impervious to hurt, referring to a past suicide attempt. Naomi reads it as an attempt to hurt her and names specific harms. She states a pause she does not hold.
incidents.outcome: Naomi states she has said her piece (G108). Does not hold — AFT-09 follows 17.2 min later.

incidents.label: Renewed accusation — ADHD/dyslexia disclosure — exit-as-regulation
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi demands he scroll up; Alex cites ADHD and dyslexia, states he is getting worked up, and exits. Naomi disputes the applicability.
incidents.outcome: Alex exits (G199). G088 follows. One post-exit turn remains (AFT-10).

incidents.label: Post-exit communication style complaint — session close
incidents.neutral_description: Single post-exit turn 45.8 minutes later objecting to backhanded inferences. Closes S-AM-4; ~7.8-day gap follows.
incidents.outcome: S-AM-4 closes at 23:04:44. ~7.8-day gap before S-AM-5.

incidents.label: Warm reciprocal exchange — S-AM-5 opening — 129 minutes
incidents.neutral_description: 129 minutes of warm reciprocal exchange — banter, a drop-off offer, an in-joke run. Retained as context; necessary to read AFT-12.
incidents.outcome: Transitions to AFT-12 when Naomi raises dinner debt at G207 (21:14:31). Elapsed since G061: 1m28s.

incidents.label: Dinner debt trigger — conflict fatigue — Alex's final recorded event
incidents.neutral_description: Naomi raises the dinner debt 1m28s after the last warm turn. Alex reads it as reopening the conflict and exits 344 seconds later — his final recorded event.
incidents.outcome: Alex's final recorded event at 21:20:15. Naomi continues 28 min / 6 turns / 765 words (AFT-13).

incidents.label: Final accountability protest — no closure — corpus end
incidents.neutral_description: 28.5 minutes, 6 turns, 765 words, no reply. Naomi names AFT-06 as the exception proving the absence and appeals to the record. Corpus ends mid-protest.
incidents.confidence: High for Naomi's audio. Nishant claim: participant account only.
incidents.outcome: Corpus ends at G084, 21 July 21:48:45 (CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md §3). No Alex response. No agreed close.

claim_status_notes.G211: Naomi's claim about prior knowledge via Nishant — participant account only. Second corpus instance (first: G094, AFT-05). No corpus event independently establishes this claim. Naomi frames it as factual ('canonical truth', 'you can't argue with the record') — this framing is itself Naomi's account.

structural_patterns.statement: The retrieval deadlock recurs three times with the same shape: one party asks the other to name the thing first; neither does.
The acknowledgement demand is mutual — four Aftermath instances each. Neither party is only asking or only withholding.
Naomi's voice-message timing account is stated four times and never engaged with on its merits. The timing record supports it.
Exits are declared more often than held: 2 of 11 Conflict-phase sign-offs held. Both parties continue after stating they are finished.
One acknowledgement occurred and did not survive the session it occurred in.
Warmth and conflict-adjacency are separable: 129 warm minutes collapse in under six once the dinner debt is raised.
The corpus has no closure event. It ends mid-protest, one-sided.

known_limits: Alex's side of S-AM-2 and S-AM-3 is absent from the corpus; AFT-04 and AFT-05 are Naomi's audio only. Confidence: Moderate.
B122/B127/B128 are untranscribable; paraphrase only from CURRENT_STATE_CLEAN.md §8.5.
The Nishant prior-knowledge claim (G094, G211) has no corroborating corpus event. Participant account only.
No event-level assignment audit exists for the 221 Conflict events; CONF-01 through CONF-03 are not audited to the AFT standard.
Conflict phase start unresolved: phase table says Jun 23; no CONF incident covers Jun 23-25.
The corpus ends at 2026-07-21T21:48:45. Nothing after that is known.
All Aftermath events are kind=audio; asymmetry figures are upper bounds within the audio channel only.
